name: @ai-crew-suite/tempo-container
description: Grafana Tempo distributed tracing backend container for tracking microservice execution span timelines across the AI Crew Suite platform

scripts.build: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image build grafana-container
scripts.lint: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image lint grafana-container
scripts.image:test:security: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image test security grafana-container
scripts.image:test:structure: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image test structure grafana-container
scripts.publish: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image publish grafana-container
